important_original_tool_semantics: In frozen comparator summarize(), origin_relative_updates uses A_B error/update cosine even when nested under A_A or AA_B. This summary reads common update norms there, but recomputes each pair denominator/cosine from actual pair difference_norm; it does not rewrite original fields.
quantiles: Empirical quantiles of logical tensor maximum errors, not element error quantiles.
violation_counts: Fixed_numeric_results sums category checks; model/master/alias can check the same parameter more than once. Counts are not unique parameter counts.
